explanation: Zero at every D1 and GO step and at all D2 steps except the D2 right after a rare a1 -> S2 transition; there it is high, about 10 if the previous trial was unrewarded and about 6-8 if it was rewarded. This only happens around trials 70-85 of the episode; rare a1 -> S2 transitions earlier (before about 65) or later (after about 87) stay at 0, or near 2 at most.
